## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.69%) ABOVE TREND provide two independent confirmations of lower fear and supportive credit while Stocks vs Bonds (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +1.77%) is ABOVE TREND.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND; Credit mixed: HYG (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.69%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -0.31%) BELOW TREND signals uneven credit. Reflation bias: CPER (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +11.52%) ABOVE TREND is pushing cyclical flows ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals leading: XLE (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, XAR (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +14.01%) ABOVE TREND and Industrial ETFs (ITA/XME) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -1.49% | 1M: -0.30%) BELOW TREND. Style: Value over Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
EM/China outperforming the US: EEM (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +2.83%) ABOVE TREND, while SPY (1W: -0.39% | 1M: +0.84%) is in CORRECTION.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows elevated: IBIT (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +2.01% | 1M: +0.69%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +0.69% | 1M: +1.75%) ABOVE TREND signal risk-on positioning and search for alpha.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad reflation: CPER (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +11.52%) ABOVE TREND and DBB (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.25%) ABOVE TREND; precious metals are rotating with GLD (1W: -2.01% | 1M: +5.56%) in CORRECTION and SLV (1W: -2.97% | 1M: +30.03%) in CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing strength: XLE (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +2.24% | 1M: -0.97%) in RECOVERY, while natural gas UNG (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -24.69%) is BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy/Industrials (XLE/ITA/XAR) ABOVE TREND and EM (EEM/FXI) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: SPY in CORRECTION and GLD/SLV in CORRECTION represent short‑term rotations — classified as MINOR divergence rather than a regime shift.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and EM exposure (XLE (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to tech/large-cap momentum (XLK (1W: -1.49% | 1M: -0.30%) BELOW TREND, QQQ (1W: -1.03% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND) and monitor credit spreads (HYG/LQD divergence).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials XAR (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +14.01%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -1.49% | 1M: -0.30%) BELOW TREND; Utilities XLU (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial commodities CPER (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +11.52%) ABOVE TREND; Brent BNO (1W: +2.24% | 1M: -0.97%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -2.01% | 1M: +5.56%) CORRECTION; Natural gas UNG (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -24.69%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) with VXX (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD watch around 0.80 as credit pivot with HYG (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.69%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -0.31%) BELOW TREND; Tech vs Financials ratio at 2.5604 (1W: -2.90% | 1M: -5.78%) BELOW TREND is a structural pivot to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive with VXX (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.69%) ABOVE TREND confirming lower fear and supportive risk conditions. Energy and Industrials showing strength—XLE (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND and XAR (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +14.01%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: short‑term rotation into commodities/EM and tech weakness—XLK (1W: -1.49% | 1M: -0.30%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: -0.39% | 1M: +0.84%) in CORRECTION to monitor.
